$schema-note: ADR-U053 §1/§2 — how scripts/replay-migrations.js builds a FRESH project from the chain when the chain alone cannot. Two kinds of entry. `recordOnly`: migrations that cannot execute on an empty project and are RECORDED as applied (exactly what `supabase migration repair --status applied` does) rather than executed — each names why it is production-history-only and what subsumes its effect; both histories still carry the version, so scripts/migration-drift.js sees no drift. `seedsBefore` / `seedsAfterAll`: the hand-run seed files under supabase/seeds/ that production received outside the migration history, replayed at the point in the chain where production had them (seeds 01–04 before the first migration that depends on them) or after the whole chain (the idempotent seed 06). Seeds are not migrations and are recorded nowhere; `seedsBefore` runs only when its anchor migration is about to be applied, so a resumed run never re-seeds. Adding an entry is a schema-gate matter: never a way to skip a migration that should run. First built 2026-09-05 (FringeIsland-test, the ADR-U053 seed pre-flight).
